name: application-mention-notification-row
title: Mention Notification Row
description: "X mentioned you in Y" notification row with an avatar, a quoted message snippet, a relative timestamp, and an unread dot, linking to the mention.
useWhen: Surfacing @-mention notifications in a chat, comments, or collaboration product.
You want the message context (channel/thread) and a snippet of the actual text, not just 'you were mentioned'.
Users need a one-click way to jump straight to the mention in its original context.
avoidWhen: The notification isn't a mention with quotable text — use notification-center's generic row instead.
You need to show many notification types together with different icons/verbs — use activity-feed for a mixed stream.
There's no snippet available — omit the quoted line rather than rendering an empty one.
responsiveBehavior: The row is a fixed max-w-md block that fills its container's available width up to that cap at all breakpoints.
accessibility: The entire row is a single link, giving one large click/tap target rather than requiring precision on a small icon.
The unread indicator is a supplementary visual dot; read/unread state should also be reflected in list-level grouping or a badge count elsewhere in your UI.
The snippet is real quoted text, not an image, so it remains selectable and readable by screen readers.

variants.title: Mention notification row
variants.description: Avatar with unread dot, 'Ana Torres mentioned you in #design-review', a quoted snippet, and a relative timestamp.
accessibility: The actor's name and the mentioning channel are both real text elements, not embedded in an image.

variants.title: Mention notification row (Dark)
variants.description: Mention notification row adapted for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Snippet background and unread-dot colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark surfaces.
